requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL expose Bun OM core object-system parity APIs for historical entity views, property-filtered type search, and explicit validation/finalization helpers while preserving existing public methods.

case.given: An entity has multiple temporal versions of properties and outgoing edges
case.when: A caller invokes GetEntityViewAsOfAsync with a historical timestamp
case.then: C# OM SHALL return the entity id, canonical type, label, properties effective at that timestamp, and outgoing edges effective at that timestamp

case.given: A computed property reads another property that changed over time
case.when: A caller invokes GetEntityViewAsOfAsync for an earlier timestamp
case.then: The computed property SHALL be evaluated through an as-of-aware context and reflect historical values

case.given: Multiple entities of a type hierarchy have current properties
case.when: A caller searches by type with property equality filters
case.then: C# OM SHALL return only matching entities using canonical property names and the same exact/polymorphic type semantics as existing FindByTypeAsync

case.given: A caller requests property-filtered type search
case.then: Each result SHALL include id, typeName, label, and current canonicalized properties without changing the existing lightweight FindByTypeAsync contract

case.given: A caller wants to preflight a property write
case.when: The caller invokes the public property type validation API
case.then: C# OM SHALL validate the effective attribute definition, aliases, and value type without writing the property

case.given: A caller wants to preflight a relation write
case.when: The caller invokes the public relation validation API
case.then: C# OM SHALL validate canonical relation names, endpoint entity existence, subtype compatibility, and undirected reverse endpoint compatibility without writing an edge

case.given: An entity is missing required inherited or mixin attributes
case.when: The caller invokes the public required-property validation API
case.then: C# OM SHALL return the missing canonical attribute names

case.given: An entity may be incomplete or violate constraints
case.then: C# OM SHALL run required-property, type, and runtime constraint validation and fail with diagnostics when the entity is not complete

requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL align computed-property inheritance and runtime constraint scope semantics with the Bun OM reference for behavior-layer features adjacent to the core object system.

case.given: A parent type defines a computed property and a child type has an entity
case.when: The caller reads GetEntityViewAsync or GetEntityViewAsOfAsync for the child entity
case.then: The view SHALL include the inherited computed property when it is not shadowed by a child definition

case.given: A parent and child type define a computed property with the same attribute name
case.when: The caller reads the computed property or an entity view for the child entity
case.then: The child computed delegate SHALL take precedence over the parent delegate

case.given: A conditional constraint has when and then delegates
case.when: ValidateEntityAsync, SetPropertyAsync, or FinalizeEntityAsync runs validation
case.then: C# OM SHALL evaluate when first, then evaluate then only when active, and include the constraint name and message on failure

case.when: LinkEntitiesAsync mutates graph state without SkipConstraints
case.then: C# OM SHALL validate the affected source entity and roll back the edge write if the constraint fails

case.given: A constraint depends on a computed property
case.then: The validation context SHALL resolve computed properties through the same inherited computed lookup used by entity views

case.given: A parent type defines conditional or cross-entity constraints
case.when: A child entity is validated or mutated
case.then: C# OM SHALL apply inherited constraints with child overrides where names collide

requirement.statement: The repository SHALL contain tests proving the C# OM parity additions and preserving the Bun OM reference behavior for the same object-system features.

case.given: The C# OM parity APIs are implemented
case.then: Tests SHALL cover historical entity views, filtered type search with returned properties, public validation helpers, finalize behavior, computed inheritance, and conditional/cross-entity/computed-dependent/inherited constraints

case.given: Bun already implements the reference behavior
case.when: The Bun OM test suite runs
case.then: Tests SHALL continue covering getEntityViewAsOf, findByType filters/properties, validation helper exports, computed inheritance, and constraint scopes so parity regressions are observable
